outline.description: Explains who brought suit against whom, what patents were alleged infringed, how a jury found loss/guilt was established before appeal was filed.
subtopics: Litigants—Finesse Wireless LLC versus AT&T Mobility LLC/Nokia

Patents involved—the ’134 (intermodulation isolation/cancellation method)
and ’775 (digital third‐order multiplication cancellation method)
in relation to media device operation
Initial trial outcome—a unanimous jury held all asserted claims were both valid and infringed
Lump‐sum damage award $166 million calculated over remaining life span
